summary: The filing reports a securities purchase agreement under which Clean Energy Technologies sold a $147,840 convertible promissory note to 1800 Diagonal Lending for $132,000, netting $125,000 after fees. The note matures April 30, 2027, accrues 12% one-time interest, and requires nine monthly payments of $18,397.78 starting August 30, 2026. Upon default, the note converts at 85% of the lowest closing bid over the prior 10 trading days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap and Nasdaq Rule 5635(d) 19.99% limitation. The transaction is a routine working-capital financing, not a special situation event.
